Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Damaged items:
• Report the issue within 7 days of delivery.
• Send photos of the damaged item and the packaging/packing slip.
• Keep the item in the condition you received it.
• The situation is reviewed and a resolution may be arranged after verification. 
Normal returns:
• Returns are not accepted after delivery for change of mind or taste.
• Alcohol purchases also cannot be returned due to state regulations. 
So damaged shipments are treated as a shipping issue, while regular returns are generally not accepted once the order has been delivered.
